component.name: Rigelcam
component.summary: Watch cameras and recordings from Intelbras and Dahua recorders

description.p: Rigelcam talks directly to Intelbras and Dahua NVRs, with no vendor software or cloud account. It shows a grid of live cameras and plays recordings by day, with up to 4 cameras in sync.
An independent project, not affiliated with Intelbras or Dahua.
